prompt: # System Prompt: Build the "Anime Battle" Landing Page **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build a complete, production-ready landing page in a single attempt. Theme: **Anime Battle** — dynamic, intense, action-packed, manga/shonen-inspired (1990s–present aesthetic). Dark-only theme. Required sections: Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** * All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. * All design properties, layout rules, and states are applied via class or ID selectors only. * HTML remains clean, semantic (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `footer`), and agnostic of visual styling. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** Define the full token set in `:root`: ```css :root { /* Colors */ --primary: #DC143C; /* Crimson Red — primary actions */ --secondary: #0066FF; /* Electric Blue — secondary actions */ --bg-primary: #0A0A0A; /* Deep Black — page background */ --bg-secondary: #15151C; /* raised panel surface */ --text-primary: #FFFFFF; /* Lightning White */ --text-secondary: #B9B9C9; /* muted body copy on dark */ --text-success: #FFD700; /* Energy Gold */ --text-error: #FF4757; /* alert red, distinct from primary */ --border-default: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18); --border-error: #FF4757; --border-success: #FFD700; /* Theme accents */ --accent-gold: #FFD700; /* Energy Gold */ --accent-purple: #9B30FF; /* Plasma Purple */ --accent-orange: #FF6600; /* Impact Orange */ /* Shape & elevation (sharp, manga-panel look) */ --radius-sm: 2px; --radius-md: 4px; --radius-lg: 8px; --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); --glow-primary: 0 0 30px rgba(220, 20, 60, 0.55); --glow-secondary: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 102, 255, 0.55); --glow-gold: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.5); --glow-purple: 0 0 30px rgba(155, 48, 255, 0.55); /* Motion & space */ --spacing-gap: 1.5rem; --transition-fast: 0.15s; --transition-normal: 0.3s; --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); /* Stacking */ --z-dropdown: 100; --z-modal: 1000; --z-toast: 1100; /* Type */ --font-display: 'Bangers', cursive; --font-base: 'Chakra Petch', sans-serif; /* Manga panel border width */ --border-panel: 4px; } ``` * **Contrast pairing:** every dark background token pairs with light text tokens. Accent colors (crimson, blue, purple, orange) are reserved for large/bold display text, borders, glows, and button backgrounds paired with white text — never for body copy on dark backgrounds. Body copy uses `--text-primary` / `--text-secondary`. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode — Dark-Only Exception** * Dark mode must be defined and is the default: the dark palette above lives directly in `:root` as the canonical theme. * **Exception (user explicitly requested a dark-only theme):** do NOT build a light-mode variant, do NOT add `prefers-color-scheme` overrides, and omit the theme toggle and `localStorage` persistence — the dark token set is the single, sole theme. **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** * Build all layout structures with Flexbox. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an explicitly justified exception exists (e.g., `stretch` inside card bodies). * Mobile-first: rows collapse to columns below ~768px; zero horizontal scrolling at any viewport; fluid typography via `clamp()`. **1.5 Framework Default** * Use Tailwind CSS (CDN or build) for layout/spacing utilities, with all theme-specific effects (speed lines, clip-path, shake, glow, skew) defined in `style.css` under `@layer`, mapped to the CSS variables above. Reusable generic classes: `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.section`, `.container`. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** * Load via ``: **Bangers** (display/impact headlines) and **Chakra Petch** (body/UI text), bound to `--font-display` and `--font-base`. * All icons via **Google Material Symbols** (e.g., `bolt`). Forbidden: inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji used as icons. --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS **2.1 Button Component (`.btn`)** * **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum 44×44px touch target; Chakra Petch bold, uppercase, letter-spaced; 3px solid manga border; sharp radius. * **Variants:** `.btn--primary` (crimson bg, white text, `--glow-primary`), `.btn--secondary` (electric blue bg, white text, `--glow-secondary`), `.btn--ghost` (transparent, white border), `.btn--danger` (visually distinct in the dark theme). * **Hover:** brightness shift + intensified glow; `cursor: pointer`; the primary CTA may add a subtle energy-pulse animation. * **Focus:** visible ring — `outline: 3px solid var(--accent-gold); outline-offset: 3px` — for keyboard navigation. * **Active:** `transform: scale(0.97)`. * **Loading:** `aria-busy="true"`, pointer events disabled to prevent double-clicks, CSS border spinner or spinning Material Symbol; button dimensions unchanged. * **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5; filter: grayscale(1); cursor: not-allowed`. * **Success/Error:** temporary feedback states driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error` (used by the newsletter submit flow). * **Impact styling:** primary CTAs may carry `transform: skewX(-4deg)` with a counter-skewed inner span (`skewX(4deg)`) to keep the label readable. **2.2 Card Component (`.card`)** * **Default:** flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary` surface, `var(--border-panel)` solid manga border, sharp radius, `--shadow-sm`. * **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` + accent glow (`box-shadow: 0 0 30px` accent) + the theme's screen-shake animation (`@keyframes shake`, 0.3s, small translate/rotate jitter). * **Focus-within:** border shifts to the accent color with glow when a child link/button receives focus. * **Loading (skeleton):** `.card--skeleton` shimmer sweep (linear-gradient animation) that preserves layout dimensions. * **Empty state:** Material Symbol icon + short guidance text in a centered flex column. **2.3 Form & Input (`.input-group`)** — used for the Final CTA email capture * **Structure:** flex container wrapping a persistent `
